name: [DECORATIONS] Bee Garden
desc:
Build the ultimate flower garden with rare flowers, helpful bees, and fun decorations! 🐝

• 🥚 Buy eggs from conveyors and hatch unique flowers with different sizes, styles, and rare variations.
• 🐝 Collect bees that boost your income and give special bonuses to help your garden grow.
• 🌷 Decorate your garden and create a layout that stands out from everyone else.
• ⭐ Get rated by the Bee Inspector based on your garden’s beauty, rarity, and creativity.
• 🎉 Play fun events like digging, ghost hunts, rainstorms, discos, and more surprises!
• 🏆 Complete your collection and discover tons of rare flowers and bees.

Can you build the most beautiful garden? 🌼
